title: RoutingLedgerEntry
description: One routed task in a consumer project, written by tools/route.py to .claude/routing-ledger.jsonl. Version 2 adds explicit per-invocation accounting and separates execution, claimed outcome and acceptance evidence. The ledger remains human-readable JSONL. Mutations use an operating-system lock and atomic replacement; completed history remains append-only except an explicit migration or restore.

id.description: Record id: led-, then at least three digits. Assigned by route.py --record in append order.

ledger_version.description: 0: no context. 1: context. 2: context plus explicit execution status, per-attempt accounting and separate acceptance evidence. tools/validate_records.py implements a fixed JSON Schema subset, so route.py enforces version-specific requirements at its write boundary.

references.description: Always empty. Present for the same reason as ledger_version.

ts.description: ISO 8601, when the entry was written.

task_slug.description: The orchestrator's short name for the routed task.

bucket.description: sensitivity/horizon/blast, from the orchestrator's assessment line (docs/ROUTING-2-DESIGN.md section 1).

self_directed.description: Recorded for the record; not an input to resolution (D64: D40 measured it firing at 38 percent for sonnet against a 6 percent base rate).

escalations.description: Each later rung tried, in order, after first_cell failed. Empty if first_cell was not escalated past.

final_outcome.description: The orchestrator's own judgement against the task's acceptance criteria, for whichever cell or rung actually finished the task. 'unknown' when the orchestrator could not judge (task abandoned, criteria never stated).

cost_usd.description: Total reported cost for the task, summed across first_cell and every escalation. Null means unknown; measured zero is 0. Version 0/1 records always used a number.

wall_clock_s.description: Total wall clock for the task, summed the same way. Null means unknown; measured zero is 0. Version 0/1 records always used a number.

controller_run_dir.description: The Controller's runs/<id> directory name, if the Controller ran anywhere in this task's routing; otherwise null.

winning_technique.description: From the Controller's SolutionRecord.technique when it ran and produced one; null otherwise. The training signal SYSTEM.md section 8 asks logged from day one.

peak_tokens.description: The largest context size observed for this task, from tools/context_probe.py's tasks key or a transcript's usage fields. Null when source is 'none'.

window.description: The cell's model's context window in tokens (contextWindowSize), for reading peak_tokens as a fraction. Null when source is 'none'.

compactions.description: Count of compactions observed for this task: compact_boundary entries in the transcript, or large drops in peak_tokens between statusline samples. Null (not 0) means unobserved, per source.

source.description: Which of docs/COMPACTION-DESIGN.md section 5's precedence supplied the other three fields.

context.description: Present on every ledger_version 1 or 2 entry; absent on ledger_version 0. An entry with context.compactions >= 1 is excluded from route.py's capability posterior and counted toward the bucket's overflow posterior instead.

execution_status.description: Version 2 task execution state. This is separate from final_outcome, which remains the claimed task result.

attempts.description: Version 2 invocation records in execution order. Unknown measurements remain null.

acceptance.description: Execution claims are separate. acceptance-v2 capability learning requires a digest-matched frozen contract plus owned command evidence or explicit rubric review. Legacy unverified records remain readable but ineligible.
